aws:cdk:cloudformation:props.description: Administrative users for the client portal

aws:cdk:cloudformation:props.definition:
# LDRGLPRx Client Portal — AppSync GraphQL schema
#
# Auth model:
#   - Default authentication is Amazon Cognito User Pools (set on the API).
#   - User-owned types carry `owner: ID!` (= Cognito `sub`); resolvers stamp
#     `owner = ctx.identity.sub` on writes and filter by `owner` on reads via
#     a `byOwner` GSI.
#   - Admin-only fields are gated with @aws_auth(cognito_groups:["Admins"]).
#
# Resolver intent (documented here, implemented in api-stack.ts):
#   - On the first authenticated GraphQL call for a given identity (typically
#     `getMyProfile` or `upsertMyProfile`), the resolver auto-creates a
#     `UserProfile` row keyed by `ctx.identity.sub`, populating
#     `primaryEmail` from the ID-token `email` claim. The PostConfirmation
#     Lambda is the primary path for profile creation; this resolver-level
#     auto-create is defense-in-depth for users who pre-date the trigger.
#   - PostAuthentication reconciles `primaryEmail` if the Cognito email
#     attribute has been changed since last login.
#   - `secondaryEmail` is DynamoDB-only and is NEVER written to Cognito.

schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
}

# ─── Scalars / shared enums ───────────────────────────────────────────────

enum TierId {
  foundation
  optimization
  longevity
  concierge
}

enum ProgramMonth {
  M1
  M2
  M3
  M4
  MAINTENANCE
}

enum PillarId {
  mitigate
  muscle
  mind
  motivate
}

enum QueueItemKind {
  intake_review
  clinician_escalation
  rx_approval
  protocol_check
  lab_result_review
  outcome_flag
}

enum QueueUrgency { routine soon urgent }
enum QueueStatus  { pending in_progress resolved deferred }

# ─── UserProfile (owner-scoped; id = Cognito sub) ─────────────────────────

type Address {
  line1: String
  line2: String
  city: String
  region: String
  postalCode: String
  country: String
}

type UserPrefs {
  marketingOptIn: Boolean
  smsOptIn: Boolean
  timezone: String
  units: String
}

input AddressInput {
  line1: String
  line2: String
  city: String
  region: String
  postalCode: String
  country: String
}

input UserPrefsInput {
  marketingOptIn: Boolean
  smsOptIn: Boolean
  timezone: String
  units: String
}

type UserProfile {
  # Cognito `sub` — also the partition key.
  id: ID!
  # Mirror of Cognito `email` attribute, reconciled on each login.
  primaryEmail: AWSEmail!
  # DynamoDB-only; never written to Cognito.
  secondaryEmail: AWSEmail
  firstName: String
  lastName: String
  displayName: String
  dob: AWSDate
  phone: AWSPhone
  address: Address
  tier: TierId
  currentMonth: ProgramMonth
  currentPillar: PillarId
  prefs: UserPrefs
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

input UpsertMyProfileInput {
  firstName: String
  lastName: String
  displayName: String
  dob: AWSDate
  phone: AWSPhone
  address: AddressInput
  tier: TierId
  currentMonth: ProgramMonth
  currentPillar: PillarId
  prefs: UserPrefsInput
}

# ─── Program / curriculum (global config) ─────────────────────────────────

type MonthPillar @aws_iam @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  month: ProgramMonth!
  pillar: PillarId!
  title: String!
  summary: String
  objectives: [String!]!
}

type Program @aws_iam @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  description: String
  pillars: [MonthPillar!]!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

type WeeklyContent @aws_iam @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: ID!
  programId: ID!
  month: ProgramMonth!
  week: Int!
  pillar: PillarId!
  title: String!
  bodyMarkdown: String!
  resources: [Resource!]
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

type Resource @aws_iam @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  name: String!
  url: AWSURL!
}

input ResourceInput {
  name: String!
  url: AWSURL!
}

input MonthPillarInput {
  month: ProgramMonth!
  pillar: PillarId!
  title: String!
  summary: String
  objectives: [String!]!
}

input UpsertProgramInput {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  description: String
  pillars: [MonthPillarInput!]!
}

input UpsertWeeklyContentInput {
  id: ID!
  programId: ID!
  month: ProgramMonth!
  week: Int!
  pillar: PillarId!
  title: String!
  bodyMarkdown: String!
  resources: [ResourceInput!]
}

# ─── Tier / catalog (global config) ───────────────────────────────────────

type Tier @aws_iam @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: TierId!
  name: String!
  tagline: String!
  monthlyUSD: Int
  annualUSD: Int
  onboardingFeeUSD: Int
  oneTimePriceUSD: Int
  kind: String
  includedProductSlugs: [String!]!
  features: [String!]!
  description: String!
  idealFor: [String!]!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

type TierCatalog @aws_iam @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: ID!
  tiers: [Tier!]!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

input TierInput {
  id: TierId!
  name: String!
  tagline: String!
  monthlyUSD: Int
  annualUSD: Int
  onboardingFeeUSD: Int
  oneTimePriceUSD: Int
  kind: String
  includedProductSlugs: [String!]!
  features: [String!]!
  description: String!
  idealFor: [String!]!
}

input UpsertTierCatalogInput {
  id: ID!
  tiers: [TierInput!]!
}

# ─── AppConfig (global config; admin-write, auth-read) ────────────────────

type AppConfig @aws_iam @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  key: ID!
  valueJson: AWSJSON!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

input UpsertAppConfigInput {
  key: ID!
  valueJson: AWSJSON!
}

# ─── DiscoveryResponse (owner-scoped) ─────────────────────────────────────

type DiscoveryAnswer {
  questionId: String!
  valueJson: AWSJSON!
}

type DiscoveryResult {
  recommendedTier: TierId!
  tierRationale: String!
  triggeredProductSlugs: [String!]!
  triggeredLabSlugs: [String!]!
  topPriorities: [DiscoveryPriority!]!
  clinicianFlags: [DiscoveryFlag!]!
  summary: String!
}

type DiscoveryPriority {
  domain: String!
  severity: Float!
}

type DiscoveryFlag {
  questionId: String!
  reason: String!
}

type DiscoveryResponse {
  id: ID!
  owner: ID!
  answers: [DiscoveryAnswer!]!
  result: DiscoveryResult
  submittedAt: AWSDateTime!
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

input DiscoveryAnswerInput {
  questionId: String!
  valueJson: AWSJSON!
}

input SubmitDiscoveryInput {
  answers: [DiscoveryAnswerInput!]!
}

# ─── Outcome (owner-scoped weekly check-ins) ──────────────────────────────

type OutcomeScore {
  domain: String!
  score: Int!
}

type Outcome {
  id: ID!
  owner: ID!
  weekISO: String!
  month: ProgramMonth!
  week: Int!
  scores: [OutcomeScore!]!
  freeText: String
  submittedAt: AWSDateTime!
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

input OutcomeScoreInput {
  domain: String!
  score: Int!
}

input CreateOutcomeInput {
  weekISO: String!
  month: ProgramMonth!
  week: Int!
  scores: [OutcomeScoreInput!]!
  freeText: String
}

# ─── IntakeForm (owner-scoped) ────────────────────────────────────────────

type IntakeAnswer {
  questionId: String!
  valueJson: AWSJSON!
}

type IntakeForm {
  id: ID!
  owner: ID!
  version: String!
  answers: [IntakeAnswer!]!
  status: String!
  submittedAt: AWSDateTime
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

input IntakeAnswerInput {
  questionId: String!
  valueJson: AWSJSON!
}

input UpsertIntakeFormInput {
  version: String!
  answers: [IntakeAnswerInput!]!
  status: String!
}

# ─── AdminQueueItem (admin-only) ──────────────────────────────────────────

type AdminQueueItem {
  id: ID!
  kind: QueueItemKind!
  patientId: ID!
  patientLabel: String!
  summary: String!
  draftedAction: String
  urgency: QueueUrgency!
  status: QueueStatus!
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

input UpdateAdminQueueItemInput {
  id: ID!
  status: QueueStatus
  draftedAction: String
  urgency: QueueUrgency
}

# ─── Pagination ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type UserProfileConnection {
  items: [UserProfile!]!
  nextToken: String
}

type OutcomeConnection {
  items: [Outcome!]!
  nextToken: String
}

type AdminQueueItemConnection {
  items: [AdminQueueItem!]!
  nextToken: String
}

# ─── Root ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Query {
  # Owner-scoped reads.
  # `getMyProfile` auto-creates the profile from `ctx.identity.sub` +
  # ID-token email claim if missing (defense-in-depth alongside
  # PostConfirmation Lambda).
  getMyProfile: UserProfile!
  listMyOutcomes(limit: Int, nextToken: String): OutcomeConnection!
  getMyDiscoveryResponse: DiscoveryResponse
  getMyIntakeForm: IntakeForm

  # Global config (any authenticated user may read).
  getAppConfig(key: ID!): AppConfig
  getProgram(id: ID!): Program
  listWeeklyContent(programId: ID!, month: ProgramMonth): [WeeklyContent!]!
  getTierCatalog(id: ID!): TierCatalog
  listTiers: [Tier!]!

  # Admin-only.
  adminGetProfile(userId: ID!): UserProfile
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
  adminListUsers(limit: Int, nextToken: String): UserProfileConnection!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
  adminListOutcomes(
    userId: ID
    limit: Int
    nextToken: String
  ): OutcomeConnection!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
  adminListQueue(
    status: QueueStatus
    limit: Int
    nextToken: String
  ): AdminQueueItemConnection!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
}

type Mutation {
  # Owner-scoped writes. Resolvers stamp `owner = ctx.identity.sub`.
  # `upsertMyProfile` auto-creates the UserProfile row on first call,
  # seeding `primaryEmail` from the ID-token `email` claim.
  upsertMyProfile(input: UpsertMyProfileInput!): UserProfile!
  # Updates the DynamoDB-only secondary email; never propagated to Cognito.
  updateSecondaryEmail(secondaryEmail: AWSEmail): UserProfile!
  submitDiscovery(input: SubmitDiscoveryInput!): DiscoveryResponse!
  upsertMyIntakeForm(input: UpsertIntakeFormInput!): IntakeForm!
  createOutcome(input: CreateOutcomeInput!): Outcome!

  # Admin-only writes (curriculum + catalog + global config + queue).
  upsertProgram(input: UpsertProgramInput!): Program!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
    @aws_iam
  upsertWeeklyContent(input: UpsertWeeklyContentInput!): WeeklyContent!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
    @aws_iam
  upsertTierCatalog(input: UpsertTierCatalogInput!): TierCatalog!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
    @aws_iam
  upsertAppConfig(input: UpsertAppConfigInput!): AppConfig!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
    @aws_iam
  updateAdminQueueItem(input: UpdateAdminQueueItemInput!): AdminQueueItem!
    @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Admins"])
    @aws_iam
}
